items.difficultyReason: The student must model both hire costs and interpret the saving as their difference, then solve a linear equation. This is a routine transfer of the taught equation-modelling method.
items.independentDerivation: For d days, A costs 100 + 60d and B costs 85d. A saving of $125 gives 85d − (100 + 60d) = 125, so 25d = 225 and d = 9. At 9 days A costs $640 and B costs $765, a $125 difference; option C is correct.
